$doc: Player abilities (hero skills, airstrikes, spells). cooldown s; target: point (aim at ground), self (around hero) or global. mode defaults to manual; automatic picks the densest enemy group. Effects: damage + damageType, stun, freeze, slow {amount, duration} (area, radius), towerBuff, healBase (keep health), cash.

abilities.name: Airstrike
abilities.description: Call in a jet strike on a point after 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.description: Freezes every enemy in a wide circle for 2.5 s.

abilities.name: Commander's Rally
abilities.description: Towers near the Commander attack 35% faster for 8 s.

abilities.name: Artillery Barrage
abilities.description: A wide shell barrage lands on a point after 2.2 s.

abilities.name: Field Repairs
abilities.description: Engineers patch the keep: restores 20 keep health.

abilities.name: Gravity Well
abilities.description: Warps space: enemies in the area are halved in speed for 5 s.

abilities.name: Starfall
abilities.description: A falling star strikes one spot after 1.2 s: built for bosses and elites.
